subject.title: [Bug]: Write/exec tool parameters silently dropped after long conversations (content/command missing)

question: After the narrow Tool Search fix path is resolved, should this broad issue remain open until custom-provider/streaming long-session argument loss is reproduced on current main, or should maintainers split that remaining scope into a new canonical issue?
rationale: The current evidence proves a narrower Tool Search argument-forwarding bug from source, but recent user evidence and the original report describe broader long-session/provider-streaming behavior that may not be fixed by the open partial PR.

options.title: Keep broad tracker open
options.body: Keep this issue open as canonical until the Tool Search subset lands and a current-main long-session provider/channel run proves the broader symptom fixed or still present.

options.title: Split remaining scope
options.body: After the Tool Search subset lands, open or designate a narrower follow-up for custom-provider/streaming long-session argument loss and close this only with cross-links and proof.

options.title: Close after narrow fix
options.body: Close this after the Tool Search fix only if maintainers explicitly accept that the remaining provider/streaming reports are unproven or out of scope.

recommendation.title: Keep broad tracker open
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as canonical until the Tool Search subset lands and a current-main long-session provider/channel run proves the broader symptom fixed or still present.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent work spans compact local Tool Search defaults and provider streaming argument normalization, which are the two strongest current evidence paths.
